mapper.sql:
f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
AND ( INSTR(LOWER(f.name), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(COALESCE(f.ingredients, '')), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(COALESCE(f.city, '')), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(COALESCE(f.province, '')), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(COALESCE(r.name, '')), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(COALESCE(r.province, '')), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM food_alias fa WHERE fa.food_id = f.id AND INSTR(LOWER(fa.alias), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM food_tag_link fft INNER JOIN food_tag ft ON ft.id = fft.tag_id AND ft.status = 'APPROVED' LEFT JOIN food_tag_alias fta ON fta.tag_id = ft.id WHERE fft.food_id = f.id AND (INSTR(LOWER(ft.name), LOWER(#{token})) > 0 OR INSTR(LOWER(COALESCE(fta.alias, '')), LOWER(#{token})) > 0) ) )
AND f.region_id = #{regionId}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM food_tag_link x INNER JOIN food_tag t ON t.id=x.tag_id WHERE x.food_id=f.id AND t.status='APPROVED' AND t.type='TASTE' AND t.id IN #{id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM food_tag_link x INNER JOIN food_tag t ON t.id=x.tag_id WHERE x.food_id=f.id AND t.status='APPROVED' AND t.type='INGREDIENT' AND t.id IN #{id})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM food_tag_link x INNER JOIN food_tag t ON t.id=x.tag_id WHERE x.food_id=f.id AND t.status='APPROVED' AND t.type='CUISINE' AND t.id IN #{id})
AND f.latitude BETWEEN #{minLatitude} AND #{maxLatitude} AND f.longitude BETWEEN #{minLongitude} AND #{maxLongitude} AND (f.longitude >= #{minLongitude} OR f.longitude <= #{maxLongitude})

when.test: sort == 'HEAT' or keyword == null or keyword == ''

choose.otherwise: CASE WHEN LOWER(f.name) = LOWER(#{keyword}) THEN 0 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM food_alias fa WHERE fa.food_id=f.id AND LOWER(fa.alias)=LOWER(#{keyword})) THEN 1 WHEN LOWER(LEFT(f.name, CHAR_LENGTH(#{keyword}))) = LOWER(#{keyword}) THEN 2 WHEN INSTR(LOWER(f.name), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0 THEN 3 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM food_tag_link fft INNER JOIN food_tag ft ON ft.id=fft.tag_id AND ft.status='APPROVED' WHERE fft.food_id=f.id AND INSTR(LOWER(ft.name), LOWER(#{keyword})) > 0) THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, f.heat DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT LEAST(POWER(2, #{zoom})-1,FLOOR((f.longitude + 180) / 360 * POWER(2, #{zoom}))) AS cluster_x, FLOOR((1 - LN(TAN(RADIANS(LEAST(85, GREATEST(-85, f.latitude)))) + 1 / COS(RADIANS(LEAST(85, GREATEST(-85, f.latitude))))) / PI()) / 2 * POWER(2, #{zoom})) AS cluster_y, COUNT(*) AS item_count, AVG(f.latitude) AS latitude, AVG(f.longitude) AS longitude, MIN(f.latitude) AS min_latitude, MAX(f.latitude) AS max_latitude, MIN(f.longitude) AS min_longitude, MAX(f.longitude) AS max_longitude, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(f.id) END AS food_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MIN(f.name) END AS food_name FROM food f LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id=f.region_id
GROUP BY cluster_x, cluster_y ORDER BY item_count DESC, cluster_x, cluster_y LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO food_daily_visit (food_id, user_id, visit_date, visited_at) SELECT f.id, u.id, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM food f INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = #{userId} AND u.active = TRUE WHERE f.id = #{foodId} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE food_daily_visit v INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = v.user_id INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = v.food_id AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' SET v.visited_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE v.food_id = #{foodId} AND u.id = #{userId} AND v.visit_date = CURRENT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT , v.visited_at AS footprint_visited_at FROM food_daily_visit v INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = v.user_id INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = v.food_id LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY v.visited_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM food f LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
AND r.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%')
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM food_daily_visit seen INNER JOIN app_user seen_user ON seen_user.id = seen.user_id WHERE seen.food_id = f.id AND seen_user.id = #{userId} AND seen.visited_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 30 DAY )
ORDER BY
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_daily_visit preference INNER JOIN app_user preference_user ON preference_user.id = preference.user_id INNER JOIN food viewed_food ON viewed_food.id = preference.food_id WHERE preference_user.id = #{userId} AND preference.visited_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND viewed_food.region_id = f.region_id ) DESC,
f.heat DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
